act_title: The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
title: Appeal
text:
45C. Appeal.— (1) Any person aggrieved by the order passed by the adjudicating officer under

section 45B may prefer an appeal to the National Green Tribunal established under section 3 of the
National Green Tribunal Act, 2010 (19 of 2010).

(2) Every appeal under sub-section (1) shall be filed within sixty days from the date on which the copy

of the order made by the adjudicating officer is received by the aggrieved person.

(3) The National Green Tribunal may, after giving the parties to the appeal an opportunity of being

heard, pass such order as it thinks fit, confirming, modifying or setting aside the order appealed against.

(4) Where an appeal is preferred against any order of the adjudicating officer under sub-section (1),

such appeal shall not be entertained by the Tribunal unless such person has deposited with the Tribunal ten
per cent. of the amount of the penalty imposed by the adjudicating officer.
